collection_status: Superseded planning draft; not collected. Authoritative targets and requirements are in cycle2/protocol.json.
target_population: Eligible consented/reuse-permitted English text in a declared participating-source frame, not the entire internet
count_interpretation: Administrative targets, not achieved counts or a completed power analysis; no stopping according to detector success
representation: Recruit across cells without detector scores. Record refusals, exclusions, source coverage and unknown metadata. Quotas do not prove representativeness. Proficiency must be voluntarily self-reported, never inferred.
four_label_cells: Seek all four origin-by-quality combinations through independent annotation; do not discard uncertain cases silently or manufacture labels to fill quotas.
origin_evidence: Human-only: consented drafts/session history and no-generation attestation or equivalent audit. Generated: independent operator, documented model, prompt hash, settings and timestamp. Mixed/unknown: separate challenge.
generation_independence: At least three generator families in development and one held-out challenge family; external operator without detector feedback. This assistant is not an independent confirmatory generator.
grouping: Connected publisher/source, pseudonymous author, source-document, prompt-family, edit/translation and near-duplicate clusters. No cluster crosses train/tune/calibration/final. Expand recruitment if clustering collapses the split.
sampling_unit: Prespecified cluster-then-document draws within strata; record inclusion probabilities only when known. Select one negative calibration document per independent cluster per target by seed-fixed ID ordering, not score.
near_duplicates: Normalized exact hashes and word-trigram Jaccard >=0.8 screen; manual semantic/paraphrase/source-link review also required
challenge_control: Variants stay with final parent cluster. Meaning changes/translation need independent quality reannotation. Unknown origin is never a human label.
privacy: Pseudonymous IDs and evidence hashes/references; no raw consent, contacts, real names, access tokens or unnecessary personal details. Permission for text is separate from software licensing.
custody: Independent human custodian holds final/challenge texts and labels; hash commitments before unsealing; freeze model/code/features/thresholds first. Unblinding or tuning invalidates that set's confirmatory status.
